properties.evidence: proof_reading in crates/reflow2-core/src/inference.rs (main 5a94e83, unchanged in this respect since 8587728, 2026-10-16) walks each HOLDING concluding step with `&mut visited.clone()` and does `total += chain_total`. Each line therefore starts from an empty visited set and the counts are summed. The clone is right for chain_confirmed (a line is proven only if all of ITS steps are confirmed, shared ones included), but the same per-line walk also produces the total.
